in_sanskrit.name: Arjik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave Archer
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjik is a Sanskrit name derived from the epithet of Arjuna, the greatest warrior in Hindu mythology. The name Arjik means 'Brave Archer'. In the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, Arjuna is depicted as a wise, brave and compassionate warrior. He is the central figure of the Bhagavad Gita, one of the most influential texts in Hinduism.
